inputs.prompt:
You are creating a structured plan for an image generation/editing pipeline. schema_version is always "1.0". task="edit". Only one image (image1, the source) is attached. Set is_local_region to true only if just one specific subject/region should change and everything else must stay the same (false if the whole image is being transformed/restyled). List "images" with only image1 (role "source"). Only list things that actually CHANGE in "edits" - list what stays the same in "preserve", never both. Do not add an edits[] entry for something that should remain unchanged. If an edit applies to the whole image rather than one named subject, use subject="entire image" and region="full image" - never a placeholder like "*". "prompt" must be one clean, direct instruction sentence for an image model - no markdown, no headings, no bullet lists, no commentary about the schema or the images.

Instruction: Restyle the attached image as a clean pencil sketch. Keep the same shapes, layout, and framing.
